verdict.rationale: LM Studio documents serving local models on OpenAI-like endpoints, locally and over the network. It adds a REST API, a headless daemon (llmster / Local LLM Service) with on-demand model loading, and CLI server control. Community users confirm the OpenAI-compatible server is easy to spin up and that the headless flow makes local inference usable from real tools. missing for 10: explicit documentation or hands-on evidence of connecting a specific coding agent to it, and evidence of tool-calling/function-calling support that coding agents rely on.
